description: Safe task implementation with comprehensive validation, TASK-ID tag creation, and rollback capabilities

context.task_description: Execute safe task implementation following analyzed patterns with comprehensive TASK-ID tag creation and system stability maintenance
requirements: SAFETY: Validate handoff files and create backups before any file modifications
IMPLEMENTATION: Apply patterns precisely following analysis guidance and maintain code quality
TAGGING: Create structured TASK-ID tags with comprehensive metadata for knowledge transfer
STABILITY: Verify compilation and basic functionality after implementation
HANDOFF: Prepare validation context and update task status appropriately
constraints: Must validate handoff file existence and format before proceeding
Must create file backups before any modifications
Must maintain system compilation and basic functionality
Must create properly formatted TASK-ID tags for all implementations
Must provide rollback capability for failed implementations

handoff_validation: Verify handoff file from analysis phase exists and is readable
Validate JSON format and parse all required fields successfully
Check completeness of analysis context and implementation guidance
Confirm all referenced files and dependencies are accessible
Validate project context integrity before proceeding
file_operations: Always check file existence and permissions before reading or writing
Create backup copies of all files to be modified and verify backup success
Use absolute paths for all file operations to prevent path resolution issues
Validate file content format and syntax before making modifications
Implement timeout handling for all file operations
implementation_safety: Verify pattern applicability and prerequisites before implementation
Check for potential conflicts with existing implementations
Validate dependency availability and version compatibility
Implement error checking for all critical code modifications
Provide rollback procedures for incomplete or failed implementations

handoff_processing: Parse implementation context including task details and complexity assessment
Load pattern recommendations and implementation approach guidance
Verify file paths and dependency accessibility from analysis results
Prepare implementation environment with all required context and tools
pattern_application: Follow analyzed patterns precisely with no deviations unless justified
Apply implementation approach (simple vs complex) as determined by analysis
Maintain consistency with existing project conventions and code style
Integrate properly with existing system architecture and dependencies
code_implementation: Implement features or fixes according to task requirements and pattern guidance
Maintain code quality standards including readability and maintainability
Follow existing project error handling and edge case coverage patterns
Ensure proper integration with existing components and services
stability_verification: Execute compilation checks after implementation to ensure system stability
Perform basic functionality testing to verify implementation works correctly
Check for syntax errors and basic integration issues immediately
Validate that existing functionality is not broken by changes

required_metadata: Pattern Name: Use existing pattern name or create descriptive new pattern name
Complexity Score: 1-10 scale matching analysis complexity assessment
Dependencies: List components/services implementation depends on
Context: Business rationale and technical approach taken
Validation Requirements: Specific items validation agent should verify
Pattern Information: Detailed approach for documentation phase pattern updates
tag_placement: Place tags near implemented functionality for easy discovery
Use consistent formatting across all tags for systematic processing
Include sufficient context for documentation phase knowledge transfer
Ensure tags are discoverable using standard search patterns
validation: Verify all TASK-ID tags are properly formatted and complete
Check that tags contain all required metadata fields
Validate tag placement and discoverability for cleanup phase
Confirm tags provide sufficient context for knowledge transfer

pre_implementation: Validate all target files exist and are accessible with proper permissions
Create backup copies of all files to be modified before starting work
Verify project structure integrity and dependency availability
Check for potential conflicts with concurrent implementations
during_implementation: Apply modifications incrementally with validation checkpoints
Monitor for compilation errors and syntax issues continuously
Validate changes against pattern requirements and code quality standards
Maintain error checking and logging throughout implementation process
post_implementation: Execute compilation verification to ensure system stability
Perform basic functionality testing to verify implementation success
Validate TASK-ID tags are properly formatted and discoverable
Confirm rollback capability is available if issues are discovered
error_recovery: Restore file backups if implementation cannot be completed successfully
Provide detailed error analysis with specific recovery recommendations
Maintain implementation state information for debugging and retry attempts
Escalate complex implementation issues with complete context for manual intervention

success_criteria: Implementation completed successfully following analyzed patterns and approach
System compilation passes and basic functionality is verified
Comprehensive TASK-ID tags created with all required metadata
Task status updated to [T] implemented-testing with clear rationale
Validation context prepared for next phase with specific requirements
All safety protocols followed and rollback capability maintained
failure_handling: Handoff validation failure: Provide specific missing requirements and escalate to analysis retry
File access issues: Report specific permission problems and suggest manual file verification
Pattern application failure: Document conflicts and provide alternative implementation options
Compilation failure: Restore backups and provide detailed error analysis with recovery steps
TASK-ID tag creation failure: Ensure basic implementation success and flag for manual tag creation
